_comment: Locators of the Price window (PricePage), opened from the home page's dropdown (the Price Booking option). Name -> selector, or { selector, description }. Keys starting with _ are ignored. The same as agentic-qa-java's locators/pricepage.json.

test1Div.description: the TEST1 div of a Price grid cell: a div right inside the cell whose class contains model1 (PricePage.verifySelectionShown; searched inside the cell)

test2Div.description: the TEST2 div of a Price grid cell: a div right inside the cell whose class contains model2 (PricePage.verifySelectionShown; searched inside the cell)
